name: user-selection-cell
description: Ephemeral utility cell for selecting a user from the ScareVerse user list. Opens a modal overlay and resolves with the selected User object or null on cancel. Invoked via show() by other cells (e.g. artifacts-explorer-cell allowance flow). Admin-only: requires GET /api/users/ access.

mode.description: Selection mode. Currently only 'pick-one' is supported.

title.description: Title displayed in the selection overlay.

_discovery.describe: Ephemeral utility cell that opens a modal overlay for selecting a user from the platform user list. Resolves with a User object on selection or null on cancel. Used by artifacts-explorer-cell for allowance flows. Requires admin role to load user list from GET /api/users/.
use_cases: Select a user to grant access to an artifact (allowance flow)
Pick a user for assignment in admin workflows
